sections.description:
Short title and commencement

PLD 2023 Punjab Statutes 54
PLD 2023 Punjab Statutes 54
ACT XI OF 2023
PUNJAB GENERAL PROVIDENT INVESTMENT FUND
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2023
An Act to amend the Punjab General Provident Investment Fund Act, 2009
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,17th February, 2023]
No. PAP/Legis-2(139)/2021/104, dated 17.2.2023.---The Punjab General Provident Investment Fund
(Amendment) Bill, 2021, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the
Punjab on the 9th day of January 2023, and assented to by the Governor of the
Punjab on the 23rd day of January 2023, is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
It is necessary to amend the Punjab General
Provident Investment Fund Act 2009 (V of 2009) for the purposes hereinafter
appearing.
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab
as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be cited as the Punjab General Provident Investment Fund (Amendment)
Act, 2023.
(2) This Act
shall come into force at once.
